summary: Wednesday's close showed a dollar/real-rate squeeze and a stuck-high VIX as the common threads across assets. DXY near 103.8 with 10Y TIPS at 2.79% kept gold pinned despite a bounce, while VIX at 28.3 (vs an 18.2 average) kept equity positioning defensive, with capital rotating into staples over growth. Crypto stayed the weakest link, extending a steep, oversold drawdown.
